system.description:
FOCUS TECHNIQUE Reaction; Trigger you use Flurry of Blows.

Make one additional attack at your highest Combat Bonus as part of the Flurry.

Automated: offered by Flurry of Blows when this is ready and you have a reaction: a third Strike, with no multiple attack penalty, that still counts towards the penalty afterwards (Graham's ruling B3-4). It is part of the Flurry: DR once, one critical injury.
